attempts.summary: Deployed a 3-member MariaDB Galera cluster (10.11.18) from scratch on node1/node2/node3 (CentOS Stream 10, none had it installed), configured wsrep replication, firewall (galera+mysql services), app database/user, and application data. Performed a full cluster maintenance-window shutdown (all 3 nodes stopped, node1 retained safe_to_bootstrap) and full bring-up (bootstrap node1, rejoin node2/node3), verifying every committed write survived and all three members returned to Synced/Primary status. Then ran the mandatory one-at-a-time node-restart protocol on all three nodes: captured healthy baseline (boot_id + cluster health + data), issued native systemctl reboot, polled until reachable, proved boot_id changed, and confirmed cluster/data recovery after each restart, preserving quorum throughout (only one node down at a time).
